response.overview: Between the 1960s and the 1980s, Rodolfo Julio Bardi created nearly 400 murals in Buenos Aires and Vicente López. His works, integrated into the architecture, are part of the city’s everyday landscape. The film traces his path—through his murals, archives, and personal accounts—to uncover the artist behind a body of work that remains in plain sight for all to see.
